inputs.checklistItemText: Watershed name and classification not shown on cover sheet (ENV-01)
inputs.question: Is the watershed name and classification shown on the cover sheet? Look for text identifying the watershed (e.g., "West Bouldin Creek") and its classification (e.g., "Urban Watershed").

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether specific text elements (watershed name and classification) are present and visible on the cover sheet. This is a label readout and document-element presence check, not a drawing inspection of spatial relationships or a measurement task.
